newsitem.title: USA: EIS restructures, sees Q4 and Q1 charges.
newsitem.headline: EIS restructures, sees Q4 and Q1 charges.

text.p: EIS International Inc said Monday it will discontinue Surefind, its Pittsburgh on-line data backup and recovery services business, and lay off about a fourth of its estimated 400-person workforce.
The restructuring will result in charges in the next two quarters, the company said.

"We've done this restructuring and reorganization so that we can go back to focusing on the core business, which is the systems piece of the business," said company Senior Vice President Carol Blaszczynski.
The company's systems business includes its call center management software and services, such as software that handles outbound telemarketing.
Blaszczynski said the company would detail fourth quarter charges when it released financial results at month's end.
As part of the restructuring, the company will close its corporate office in Pittsburgh and downsize Cybernetics, which develops and sells the "Workforce Manager" management product.
The company said it will also close a facility in Coral Gables, Fla., and integrate Pulse, the Chantilly, Virginia-based subsidiary, into its systems business.
Blaszczynski said many of the layoffs were effective Friday, and others go into effect today.
